source.title: Active inference on discrete state-spaces: A synthesis

confidence_rationale: This is the equation-level synthesis that makes WS-5's core point precise. It shows verbatim that (a) the approximate posterior FACTORISES under a mean-field approximation over hidden-state factors, and (b) expected free energy is a SUM of separable epistemic (salience + novelty) and extrinsic (risk) terms -- i.e. active inference optimises a factorized functional, not an undifferentiated scalar. That directly WEAKENS REE's 'active inference is just one scalar' objection (a strawman as stated). Simultaneously it pins the GENUINE departure: every term of G(pi) is measured in nats and summed, so risk + ambiguity is one commensurable number -- the exact common-currency assumption MECH-069/ARC-021 reject. Confidence moderate: it is a normative-mathematical paper (no empirical test of incommensurability), and the mapping onto REE's three specific channels is interpretive.
failure_signatures: Expected free energy is explicitly assembled as risk + ambiguity (state pathway) or, dually, negative extrinsic value + negative epistemic value -- all in nats and additively combined. This is the concrete existence proof that reward-seeking and information-seeking are COMMENSURABLE and summable, which is the assumption REE's incommensurability claim denies. If a single summed functional over factorized states can reproduce REE's mode/credit behaviour, MECH-069's strong form is unsupported.

The mean-field factorisation Q(s_1:T | pi) = product over tau of Q(s_tau | pi), and the factorisation over distinct hidden-state factors, show active inference already SEPARATES representational dimensions. So REE cannot claim novelty for 'separate channels' -- only for the stronger claim that the separated channels' errors cannot be re-combined into any shared scalar, which this paper does not test and its formalism does not require.

Precision here (including policy precision gamma with its Gamma prior) is a scalar/low-dimensional gain on a common surprise currency. It provides no distinct, non-exchangeable precision axes, so ARC-016's multi-axis precision is an addition NOT licensed by this formalism and must be independently justified.

mapping.source_claim_statement: On discrete state-spaces, active inference minimises variational free energy for inference/learning and expected free energy G(pi) for policy selection. The approximate posterior factorises under a mean-field approximation: Q(s_1:T | pi) = product_tau Q(s_tau | pi), with a further mean-field factorisation across distinct hidden-state factors. G(pi) decomposes into extrinsic value (expected log preference = reward/utility = negative Bayesian risk) and intrinsic/epistemic value (expected information gain about hidden states = salience, and about parameters = novelty; the latter underwrites artificial curiosity). Best policies minimise G(pi), yielding behaviour that is simultaneously risk-minimising (exploitative) and ambiguity-resolving (exploratory). Precision over policies (gamma) provides a plausible description of dopaminergic discharge.
mapping.ree_translation: The factorisation results are the load-bearing citation for WS-5: they establish that active inference optimises a FACTORIZED objective over FACTORIZED states, so REE's stated objection ('one scalar') attacks a position the framework does not hold. REE's real, defensible departure is narrower and sharper: G(pi) sums risk and ambiguity in a single currency (nats), i.e. it assumes the value of information and the value of reward are COMMENSURABLE. ARC-021/MECH-069 assert that sensory-prediction, motor-sensory and harm/goal errors have NO common currency -- forcing them through any shared scalar mis-attributes credit even after factorisation. The mean-field precision here is also single-currency, which frames ARC-016's multi-axis precision as an explicit (and still-unproven) enrichment rather than a re-derivation.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Normative-mathematical synthesis, not an empirical test. It cannot confirm or refute incommensurability; it supplies the precise null (a commensurable, factorized, summed functional) that REE's strong claim must out-predict. Reading it as 'support' for MECH-069 would invert its role -- it is the sharpest statement of the position MECH-069 departs from, and the source of the falsifier design (forced-shared-loss ablation must fail to converge to correct credit regardless of capacity).
mapping.source_context: Discrete (categorical) state-space active inference; partially-observed Markov formulation; theoretical with in-silico neurophysiological illustrations.

confidence_components.notes: High source quality (definitive open-access mathematical synthesis, J Math Psych). Mapping fidelity moderate: the factorisation and epistemic/extrinsic decomposition map cleanly to the argument, but the incommensurability translation is interpretive. Transfer risk moderate-high: importing a normative discrete-state calculus into REE's E1/E2/E3 architecture, and turning 'commensurable-but-decomposed' into a falsifiable REE experiment, both add steps.
